title: ERSEM-ALLOC: zero-dimensional phytoplankton allocation and irradiance sensitivity benchmarks
description: Reproducible PyFABM/ERSEM-ALLOC 0D physiological sensitivity experiments: prescribed carbon-fixation allocation fraction, instantaneous balanced chlorophyll-to-carbon response to irradiance, and gross fixation P-I curves. Digitised experimental context from Geider et al. (1997), Fig. 3A. The experiments do not validate prognostic allocation. Developed with support of ESA; ESA Climate Assessment and Model Parameterisation (CAMP): Official ESA CAMP project webpage. Requires a compatible externally versioned compiled FABM/ERSEM/PyFABM installation.
notes: Draft metadata. Review licenses, creator list, software citation and compiled model source revision before Zenodo release.
